title: InnovaTeQ and Felelősségteljes IT: SEO and AI-search review
lede: A prioritised list for innovateq.io and felelosit.hu. Each item says what to change, why it matters, how to fix it and roughly how long it takes. Everything is checked read-only: no forms submitted, no load tests.
meta: Checked: https://innovateq-website.innovateq-solutions.workers.dev/ (staging), https://innovateq.io/; https://felelosit.hu/. Automated collectors: HTTP crawl, robots/sitemap/llms.txt, on-page meta, JSON-LD. Optional: Lighthouse, keyword APIs, live AI answers (see agent checklist).
method: Method: read-only HTTP checks of seed + sitemap URLs, on-page SEO extraction, robots.txt / sitemap / llms.txt, JSON-LD entity scan. Keyword volumes, backlink graphs and live ChatGPT/Perplexity answers are filled by the auditing agent when enabled. No forms submitted, no load tests.
summary: **InnovaTeQ:** 0 P0 item(s), 8 findings total, 4 strengths noted.
**Felelősségteljes IT:** 0 P0 item(s), 4 findings total, 4 strengths noted.
Each finding says what to change, why it matters, how to fix it and roughly how long it takes. Checks are read-only: no forms submitted, no load tests.

sites.name: InnovaTeQ
alreadyDoneWell: Sitemap discoverable and referenced from robots.txt.
Structured data includes organisation-like types: Organization.

findings.title: Fix titles, meta descriptions and H1s
findings.what: 1 page(s) with no H1; 6 page(s) with multiple H1s
findings.why: Titles and a single clear H1 are the baseline for both classic SEO and AI citation snippets.
findings.fix: Give every indexable page a unique title, a meta description, and exactly one H1 that matches the page intent.

findings.title: Richer structured data (sameAs, founder, services)
findings.what: Organisation schema exists but is thin: missing sameAs profile links and/or founder / Service / article markup.
findings.why: With a shared or ambiguous name, schema is how Google and AI systems tell this business apart.
findings.fix: Extend Organization/ProfessionalService with address, vatID/taxID, foundingDate, areaServed, knowsAbout, sameAs. Add Person for the founder, BlogPosting on articles, BreadcrumbList on inner pages.

artifacts.name: sample-organization-schema.json

findings.title: A proper social preview image
findings.what: og:image is set but twitter:card is "summary" (prefer summary_large_image with a 1200×630 image).
findings.why: Shared links on LinkedIn otherwise show a cropped logo or empty preview.
findings.fix: Create one 1200×630 image (logo + headline), set as default og:image, use summary_large_image.

findings.title: The contact form posts to mailto:
findings.what: Found mailto form action(s): https://innovateq-website.innovateq-solutions.workers.dev/book-a-call/ → mailto:info@innovateq.io; https://innovateq-website.innovateq-solutions.workers.dev/request-tailored-offer/ → mailto:info@innovateq.io; https://innovateq-website.innovateq-solutions.workers.dev/thank-you/ → mailto:info@innovateq.io; https://innovateq-website.innovateq-solutions.workers.dev/contact/ → mailto:info@innovateq.io
findings.why: This is a conversion issue more than an SEO one, but it is the page SEO work sends people to. On many phones and locked-down work machines, mailto does nothing.
findings.fix: Post to a real form endpoint (HubSpot, Formspree, etc.) and show the email address as plain-text fallback.

findings.title: Search demand and content fit
findings.what: Configured focus themes/keywords to validate with search-volume data: performance engineering consulting, observability consulting, incident root cause analysis, monitoring strategy, performance testing consultancy.
findings.why: Category keywords often have tiny demand for advisory businesses; buyers search symptoms or ask AI assistants.
findings.fix: Pull monthly volumes (DataForSEO / Ads Keyword Planner) for the configured markets, then write problem-led pages that open with a two-sentence direct answer and link to the matching service.

agentAction.notes: Fill volumes via keyword collector or agent research, then prioritise content.

findings.title: How AI search sees the brand (manual / API pass)
findings.what: Live ChatGPT / Perplexity / AI Overview answers were not auto-fetched in this run. Use the configured questions.
findings.why: Assistants still describe brands from old crawls; redirects and llms.txt decide how fast that updates.
findings.fix: Ask each question with web search enabled, record citations, and compare to the intended positioning. Re-run 2–4 weeks after major changes.
evidence: Independent performance and observability consultants in Hungary or Europe

findings.title: Win the brand search on purpose
findings.what: Brand strings to verify in Google (GB, US, HU): InnovaTeQ, InnovateQ, InnovaTeQ Solutions. Known namesakes/competitors: https://innovateq.digital/, https://innovateq.com.au/.
findings.why: Prospects who hear the name will search it. They need to land on the right domain, not a namesake.
findings.fix: Put brand + place + category together in the home title or first paragraph. Align LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and other sameAs profiles on the exact name and URL.

findings.title: Connect related brands through a shared person/entity
findings.what: Configured related sites: InnovaTeQ, Felelősségteljes IT.
findings.why: Shared founders should be one Person entity referenced from each site. Do not use hreflang unless the content is the same page in different languages.
findings.fix: Pick one Person @id on the primary site and reference it from the other. Add one bio line on each site pointing at the sibling brand where it genuinely helps the reader.
